blocks.orig: The Sea Cliff Hotel is perched on a cliff on the Msasani Peninsula, just five kilometres from the bustling centre of Dar Es Salaam, and combines modern comfort with lush manicured gardens and stunning ocean views. The 93 well-appointed rooms are decorated in wood tones and fitted with an ensuite bathroom, satellite TV, a minibar, tea and coffee facilities and a digital safe. No less than 2 restaurants and a café cater to your cravings with local and international specialities. Among them is the Alcove Restaurant, one of the oldest restaurants in Dar es Salaam. Relax in the outdoor pool, enjoy sundowners in the well-stocked bar, work out in the gym or get pampered in the beauty salon.
blocks.html: Sitting on a cliff on the Msasani Peninsula, only five kilometres from the busy centre of Dar Es Salaam, the Sea Cliff Hotel brings together modern comfort, green, well-kept gardens and beautiful ocean views. Its 93 comfortable rooms are finished in wood tones and come with an ensuite bathroom, satellite TV, a minibar, tea and coffee facilities and a digital safe. Two restaurants and a café serve local and international dishes for whatever you are craving. One of them is the Alcove Restaurant, among the oldest restaurants in Dar es Salaam. Unwind in the outdoor pool, have sundowners at the well-stocked bar, train in the gym or treat yourself at the beauty salon.
